Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Banking and Finance BoG hosts Queen of Netherlands to discuss Ghana’s financial health Source : Ebenezer Sabutey 4 November 2026 5:26pm Audio By Carbonatix
The Bank of Ghana Governor, Dr. Johnson Pandit Asiama, has welcomed the Queen of Netherlands, Queen Maxima, to a leadership roundtable on financial health in Ghana.
Speaking to welcome the Queen, who also doubles as the United Nations Secretary-General’s Special Advocate for Financial Health, the Governor highlighted the country’s financial achievements and some challenges facing the sector.
Queen Maxima visited Ghana in her capacity as the United Nations Secretary-General’s Special Advocate for financial health.
As part of the activities of her visit, she joined the Bank of Ghana for the leadership roundtable on financial health in the country.
In his welcome address, the Governor, Dr. Johnson Pandit Asiama, said the country has improved in digital finance but is still facing challenges of accessibility.
“Ghana's financial sector has undergone a remarkable transformation over the past decade. Through innovation, collaboration and investment in digital infrastructure, financial services have become more accessible to millions of Ghanaians”.
“Today, Ghana stands among Africa's leading digital finance markets, supported by interoperable payment systems, mobile money, fintech innovation and a regulatory environment that has fostered both growth and trust,” he said.
Queen Maxima used the opportunity to commend Ghana for the consistency in pushing financial access to all sectors of the economy.
She therefore urged the Central Bank to begin to assess the financial health of bank customers in order to measure the impact of the various banking products that are introduced.
